svg.text: THIS module: case, its own drawers / wheels, and scheduled doors.
Images show actual saved model geometry; exploded views are identification aids.
1. Build the case: Back, full-height Sides, Bottom, Top and niche shelves.
2. Prepare cable passages and dry-fit this niche's LED profile.
3. Trial-fit the door with the selected hinges; retain access to the driver compartment.
4. Finish wall fixing and door adjustment during final installation; support it until secured.
